description: Single-panel schematic (Fig. 7, "Architecture of genetic algorithm") depicting a GA chromosome encoding and crossover as four stacked horizontal rows of nine coloured gene cells. Row 1, "Parent 1", is a permutation chromosome labelled left to right 3, 1, 4, 2, 5, 8, 7, 6, 9. Row 2, "Parent 2", has only its first two cells labelled 8 and 4; its remaining seven cells show colour but no visible numbers. Row 3, "Offspring 1", is labelled 3, 1, 4, 8, 2, 5, 7, 6, 9. Row 4, "Offspring 2", repeats Parent 2's colour pattern and contains no visible numbers in any cell. Cells carry three colour codes — grey, pale teal and mid-blue — marking the gene blocks: Parent 1 and Offspring 1 have grey at positions 1-3 and 8-9 with pale teal at positions 4-7 (values 2, 5, 8, 7); Parent 2 and Offspring 2 have mid-blue at positions 1-3 and 8-9 with pale teal at positions 4-7. Offspring 1 keeps Parent 1's colour blocks but its teal genes are reordered to 8, 2, 5, 7, illustrating crossover/reordering. No axes, scale bars, legends or numeric performance values are printed.

subfigures.description: A nine-cell chromosome row labelled 'Parent 1' with gene values 3, 1, 4, 2, 5, 8, 7, 6, 9; cells 1-3 and 8-9 are grey, cells 4-7 (values 2, 5, 8, 7) pale teal.
A nine-cell chromosome row labelled 'Parent 2'; only cells 1 and 2 contain visible numbers, 8 and 4. Cells 1-3 and 8-9 are mid-blue, cells 4-7 pale teal; cells 3-9 carry no legible numbers.

A nine-cell offspring row labelled 'Offspring 1' with values 3, 1, 4, 8, 2, 5, 7, 6, 9; the same grey/teal colour blocks as Parent 1, but the teal block has been reordered to 8, 2, 5, 7 relative to Parent 1's 2, 5, 8, 7.
A nine-cell offspring row labelled 'Offspring 2' shown with Parent 2's colour pattern (mid-blue at 1-3 and 8-9, pale teal at 4-7) but with no visible gene numbers in any cell.

observations.observation: The figure consists of four nine-cell horizontal chromosome rows labelled, top to bottom, 'Parent 1', 'Parent 2', 'Offspring 1' and 'Offspring 2'.
Offspring 1 reads, left to right, 3, 1, 4, 8, 2, 5, 7, 6, 9, i.e. it matches Parent 1 except that the block values 2, 5, 8 have been reordered to 8, 2, 5.
Parent 2 shows the numbers 8 and 4 in its first two cells; cells 3-9 are drawn but carry no visible gene values.
Offspring 2 is drawn with the same colour pattern as Parent 2 but contains no visible numbers in any of its nine cells.

Cells are colour-coded in three shades (grey, pale teal, mid-blue): Parent 1 and Offspring 1 have grey cells at positions 1-3 and 8-9 with pale teal at positions 4-7, whereas Parent 2 and Offspring 2 have mid-blue at positions 1-3 and 8-9 with pale teal at positions 4-7.
The pale teal block occupies cells 4-7 in all four rows, marking the chromosome segment involved in the operation, while the flanking cells take the colour of the originating parent.
No axes, scale bars, legends, curves or printed numeric performance values appear; the figure is purely a schematic of chromosome encoding and parent-to-offspring gene transfer.
The caption states that Fig. 7 shows the architecture of a genetic algorithm.

The citing text states that the GA is applied to hyper-parameter optimization of the Extra Trees model and that the specific structure of the GA is illustrated in Fig. 7; the image itself shows only chromosome/crossover mechanics, not selection, fitness evaluation or mutation steps.
